map.输入气温与相对湿度，按Magnus公式反算露点温度Td，用于判断结露、雾与霜的形: Enter air temperature and relative humidity, and back-calculate dew point Td with the Magnus formula to judge the conditions for condensation, fog and frost.
map.露点 Td = Magnus 公式反解: Dew point Td = inverse of the Magnus formula
map.由气温与相对湿度，按 Magnus 公式反算露点温度 Td。: Back-calculate the dew point temperature Td from air temperature and relative humidity using the Magnus formula.
map.由气温与相对湿度算露点（空气冷却到凝结的温度）。: Dew point from air temperature and relative humidity (the temperature air must cool to for condensation).
map.露点高=闷、露点接近气温=快饱和要下雨。: High dew point means muggy; dew point close to air temperature means near saturation and rain coming.
map.仓储/制药控露点防凝露。: Dew point control for condensation prevention in warehousing / pharma.
map.：气温 20°C、RH 95% → 露点≈19.1°C，与气温差<1°C，极易凝: : air 20°C, RH 95% → dew point ≈19.1°C, a gap of less than 1°C from air temperature, so condensation or fog is very likely.
map.露点比气温高可能吗？: Can dew point be higher than air temperature?
map.不可能。露点≤气温，差越小越潮湿，差为负说明数据异常。: Impossible. Dew point ≤ air temperature; the smaller the gap the more humid, and a negative gap means the data is abnormal.
map.露点有什么用？: What is the dew point good for?
map.判断结露、雾、霉变风险，也用于空调除湿目标设定（降到露点以下才凝水）。: Judge condensation, fog and mildew risk, and set air-conditioner dehumidification targets (water only condenses once cooling drops below the dew point).
